id: # Industrial design: a product from marker sketch to render, colour and material variants, other views, a 3D model ready for texturing, a turntable and an exploded view. Every run becomes an example for students of this speciality, beside the card's showcase (tools/maintenance/seed_examples.cjs --speciality industrial).

caption: An ideation sketch of a cordless kettle, fineliner and grey marker with a coral accent, made from words as a stand-in for a scanned sketch. The next examples turn it into a product.
prompt: Industrial design sketch on white marker paper: a single large three-quarter view of a cordless electric kettle, drawn with confident black fineliner lines, a soft rounded body, a wide curved handle, a short spout and a round charging base, the body shaded with soft grey marker, one accent of coral orange marker on the handle, a few construction ellipses left visible. Nothing else on the page, flat lay, evenly lit.

caption: The sketch turned into a studio product shot that follows its lines exactly: compare the spout, the lid, the handle and the base with the drawing. Watch for one thing: the centre construction line of the sketch became a bright seam down the body. Clean a sketch's construction lines before using this card.
prompt: Studio product photograph of a cordless electric kettle following the drawing exactly: a soft rounded body in matte warm white polymer, a coral orange soft-touch handle, a brushed steel lid, a thin glowing light ring around the base, standing on its round charging base on a seamless light grey background, soft studio light with a gentle reflection on the table.

caption: One material change asked in plain words: the body in clear glass. The water and the steel heating plate now show through, and the coral handle, the lid and the base are kept. A fast way to compare materials on the same object.
prompt: Make the body of the kettle clear borosilicate glass, so the water and the steel heating plate inside are visible, and keep the coral handle, the lid and the charging base.

caption: A product photograph of a desk lamp on white, made from words: cast-iron base, aluminium arm, tilted round head, braided cable. It feeds the colour, view and 3D examples that follow.
prompt: Product photograph of a minimalist desk lamp on a plain white background: a round weighted base of matte black cast iron, a slim vertical arm of anodised aluminium and a flat round lamp head tilted forward with a soft opal diffuser, a braided black fabric cable curving out behind. Centred, three-quarter front view, soft even studio lighting, a faint shadow under the base.

caption: A colour, material and finish (CMF) variant of the lamp: terracotta ceramic base, sage green aluminium arm and head, cream braided cable. Compare it with the lamp photo: the shape, the angle of the head and the framing are the same, only the materials changed.
prompt: In <ref_image_0>, change the colours and materials of the lamp: the base in glazed terracotta ceramic, the arm and the lamp head in anodised sage green aluminium, the cable in braided cream fabric. Keep the shape of every part, the angle of the head, the background, the light and the camera exactly the same.

caption: The lamp from the side, made from the single front photo. The base, the arm and the cable follow, but the head was reinvented as a small spotlight: an angle the photo never showed is a guess, not a drawing.

An exploded view of a Bluetooth speaker, written as a list of parts: cap, buttons, driver, circuit board, battery, body and base float in order on one axis, each with a leader line and its label spelled right.
prompt: Technical exploded-view illustration of a portable Bluetooth speaker on a white background: the parts float apart along one vertical axis, from top to bottom a grey fabric top cap, a ring of control buttons, a round speaker driver, a green circuit board, a cylindrical battery, an aluminium body tube and a rubber base. Each part has a thin leader line to a small label in black sans-serif capitals: 'CAP', 'BUTTONS', 'DRIVER', 'PCB', 'BATTERY', 'BODY', 'BASE'. Clean product rendering, soft shadows, three-quarter view.

caption: The lamp photo turned into a textured 3D model (GLB, 695,188 faces, with colour, roughness and normal maps). Spin it: the base, the arm, the head and the cable are all there, the back invented from one front view.
The same lamp reduced from 695,188 faces to 1,994, its textures kept: light enough for a real-time viewer, a game engine or a quick render. Compare the silhouette with the full model.

The low-poly lamp unwrapped for texturing: the result is the model with clean UVs, a picture of the UV islands and an ambient-occlusion bake to paint over. The step before taking the object into a texturing tool.

A turntable from the kettle render: a smooth half turn showing the handle from behind, the light and the background steady. The handle bends slightly as it turns, and the sound came out nearly silent rather than the studio ambience asked for.
prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The kettle turns slowly on a hidden turntable, a smooth half turn that shows its rounded side and the coral handle from behind, then the light ring at its base glows a little brighter. The camera stays perfectly still, the soft studio light and the grey background do not change. A quiet studio ambience and one soft click as the light ring brightens. No text, no black frames.
